title: T009 ContentDocument v1 contract proof ready for merge
summary: T009 defines a closed-world ContentDocument v1 schema and bounded fixtures. The contract keeps video providerId at a rights-pending sentinel until ADR-0003 approval, enumerates the approved court-dusk palette, accepts UUIDv7 identifiers, bounds headings to h2-h4, requires stat unit/context, rejects malformed HTTPS authority/ports and NUL characters, covers 23 focused schema-invalid fixtures across all 11 block types, and records a duplicate block-ID semantic invariant. Independent Ajv/Prettier replay and GitHub CI/Security run #65 pass; all review threads are resolved, with expected-head human merge and main read-back pending.

claims.text: T009 was dispatched from main@a75f1c2 after Phase 1 PASS read-back.
The contract must represent exactly 11 approved MVP block types.
generative-canvas is limited to court-pulse-v1, fixed seed, bounded parameters, poster asset, alt text and data summary.
T010 validator parity and generated types are not part of this slice.
Independent Ajv 8 strict validation accepted the complete fixture and rejected all 23 schema-invalid fixtures; the duplicate-ID semantic fixture was detected separately.
T009 does not authorize an external video provider; providerId is the rights-pending sentinel until ADR-0003 publisher/rights-owner approval.
Every approved block type has a focused invalid fixture, and generative code, shader and remote URL fields are tested independently.
Block IDs must be unique even when payloads differ; this semantic invariant is declared in the contract and must be enforced by T010 validators.
Required human-readable strings reject whitespace-only values through a non-whitespace schema pattern.
HTTPS hrefs use URI format plus a bounded authority/port pattern; malformed authorities and ports are rejected.

The locked repository validator was replayed independently with Node 24.14.0, Ajv 8.20.0 and ajv-formats 3.0.1; GitHub CI/Security run #65 passed on head 60e1ea0 and all current review threads are resolved.
The schema accepts UUIDv7 identifiers required by the data model.
All persisted string definitions reject NUL characters before JSONB persistence.
Repository CI runs scripts/validate-content-schema.mjs through pnpm run contract:schema.
Heading levels are bounded to h2-h4 and lower-bound coverage is isolated in a rejected fixture.
Stat blocks require label, value, unit and context; missing unit/context is isolated in a rejected fixture.
GitHub CI/Security run #65 passed on head 60e1ea0; all 10 previously unresolved review threads are resolved; expected-head merge and main read-back remain.

decision.context: Phase 1 setup/governance and CI/security baseline are complete; dependent implementation requires a versioned content contract first.
decision.chosen: Define and verify the closed-world JSON Schema and fixtures before implementing validators, renderers or API consumers.
alternatives: Start T010 validator code without a canonical schema.
Define permissive payloads and enforce safety only in renderers.
tradeoffs: Schema is safer and reviewable at the boundary.
Provider allowlists and runtime parity still require T010/T011 evidence.
Rights-pending video sentinel preserves the ADR rights gate; approved provider values remain a later decision.
decision.invalidation: If ADR-0003/0005 or tasks.md changes the allowed block/preset contract, mark this record needs_update and stop T009.
decision.proof: Ajv strict validation and Prettier replay passed the valid fixture, rejected 23 focused schema-invalid fixtures, and detected the duplicate block-ID semantic invariant; heading h2-h4 and stat unit/context boundaries are covered. Graphify and work-memory validators pass. GitHub CI/Security run #65 passed on head 60e1ea0 and all current review threads are resolved; expected-head human merge and main read-back remain.
